recentItems.title: Game Tells All on Situations w/ Drake, Kendrick Lamar, 50 Cent, Blacc Sam, YG Verzuz, Documentary 3
recentItems.description:
The Game visited Big Boy in studio in August 2026 for this all new interview celebrating the release of the Documentary 3 and clearing up direct comments Game has made about Drake, Kendrick Lamar, YG, 50 Cent, Blacc Sam and more...

The Game explains the true motivation behind putting Drake on his album and what their connection is.  The Game tells us why putting Drake on his album the Documentary 3 may upset people but its ultimately Game's decision to make the best music possible so he made the decision.  The Game explains his recent comments about why his relationship with Blacc Sam has been different since Nipsey Hussle passed away.  Why can't the Game get Kendrick Lamar on the phone?  This question is also explored and answered.

Game answers the question why so many people hate him and whose fault is it that so many people hate him?!?!  The Game explains how the legends of hip hop still inspire him to make more hit music.  Why do E40, Snoop Dogg, Too Short and more long term hip hop veterans motivate the Game to still making the best music he can?
 
The Game Plays Big Boy's The Raft Game - Drake vs Kanye West... Mister LA RJ joins The Game and Big Boy speaking on the Documentary 3 

This all new Game podcast Episode is a special part of our Big Boy 2026 Season!  Big Boy is celebrating 2026 with over 30 years as a Legend in Hip Hop Culture and Entertainment and all the stars come here to chat and have fun with Big!!
